## What's new
- Frankie now remembers the last few minutes of your voice conversation, so follow-ups like "what about that one?" just work. Only text context is kept — screenshots stay ephemeral — and it clears when you sign out. - Ask to be walked through anything on screen and Frankie guides you one step at a time, keeps its on-screen pointers up while you act, and checks your progress from a fresh look at the screen. - The active walkthrough step lives in the notch with **Done — next** and stop controls. - When you explicitly ask, Frankie can click a visible control or type into the current field — always shown in a native approval prompt first, never automatically. - The caret now shows a completion tick when Frankie finishes a task.
